international.title: British man who died in Kraków shooting named as James Campbell
international.summary: Campbell, 32, from Prestwick, South Ayrshire, was one of six people killed in the 7 November attack in Polish city The British man who died in a shooting in Kraków has been named as 32-year-old James Campbell. Campbell, of Prestwick, South Ayrshire, was one of six people killed in the 7 November shooting in the Polish city by the 24-year-old gunman, who is also suspected of murdering three members of his own family.
